meta.name: canvas-design
meta.description: Create beautiful visual art in .png and .pdf documents using design philosophy. You should use this skill when the user asks to create a poster, piece of art, design, or other static piece. Create original visual designs, never copying existing artists' work to avoid copyright violations.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 根据描述生成原创视觉设计图片和PDF文档
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要快速生成原创海报、艺术图或静态视觉设计。
copy.tagline_en: Create original visual art and PDF documents from descriptions.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly generate original posters, artwork, or static visual designs.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会先写一份设计哲学 .md 文件,再据此把想法做成海报、艺术画等静态视觉作品,最终给你可下载的 .pdf 或 .png 文件。
howto.when: 当你要求做海报、艺术画、设计等静态视觉作品时,它会接管,先立设计哲学再作画。

say.text: 帮我做一张极简风格的展览海报,输出 PNG
say.note: 先生成设计哲学,再据此出图

say.text: 把这个概念做成一份三页的 PDF 视觉作品
say.note: 会连同设计哲学 .md 一起交付

say.text: 把你写的那份设计哲学 .md 单独发给我看看
say.note: 先产出 .md,再进入画布创作

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude first writes a design philosophy as a .md file, then expresses it visually as a poster, art piece, or other static design, delivered as a downloadable .pdf or .png.
howto.when_en: Use it when you ask for a poster, a piece of art, a design, or another static visual piece; it starts with a design philosophy, then makes the artwork.

say_en.text: Make me a minimalist exhibition poster, output as PNG
say_en.note: Writes the philosophy first, then the artwork

say_en.text: Turn this concept into a three-page PDF visual work
Show me just the design philosophy .md you wrote
say_en.note: The .md comes first, then the canvas work
